answer: Reward slots for sparrow surveys or gale damage checks on a bridge can follow a trust graph. Vetted anchors supply a fixed credit budget; each endorsement edge carries at most one credit. The ledger assigns credits to earning keys in one global flow, consuming shared edge capacity. A fake-account cluster with b incoming honest endorsements can receive at most b credits, even with a million internal aliases. More access requires persuading or corrupting more honest endorsers. This assumes vetted anchors and few honest-to-attacker links.
